functions.name: HashName
functions.evidence: retail code: FNV-1a (0x811C9DC5, 0x01000193) with each byte OR 0x20; the same hash names archive records
functions.notes: Returns 0 for NULL or empty strings.

functions.name: Lua_ArgString
functions.evidence: retail code: lua_isstring then lua_tostring; on failure raises "Could not read string.  Bad argument sent to Lua API function" (0x2F00A8) and returns NULL

functions.name: Lua_ArgNumber
functions.evidence: retail code: lua_isnumber then lua_tonumber; on failure raises "Could not read Number.  Bad argument sent to Lua API function" (0x2F0028) and returns 0

functions.name: Lua_ArgBool
functions.evidence: retail code: returns (0x1DCD80(L, n) == 1)

functions.name: Lua_ArgVector3

functions.evidence: inferred: Lua_Mission_Spawn calls it with (&v, L, 3) for its x, y, z arguments and then reads v as three floats

functions.name: Lua_ArgActor

functions.name: Lua_ToActorRef

functions.name: Lua_PushActor

functions.name: ActorRef_Resolve
functions.evidence: inferred: second step of Lua_ArgActor

functions.name: LuaScript_FromState

functions.name: Spawner_SpawnTemplate
functions.signature: SpawnResult * __thiscall Spawner_SpawnTemplate(Spawner *this, uint32 templateHash, const char *name, const Matrix *transform, int, int)
functions.evidence: retail code: Lua_Mission_Spawn(template, name, x, y, z, yaw) calls it on the object at 0x4031B0 with HashName(template), name, a transform built from the position and yaw (degrees x 0.0174533), 0, 0; the new actor is at result + 8
functions.notes: Spawns any object template by name hash: the core of spawning by name.
